notes.title: Command Deck is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p]Command Deck is now available in Early Access![/p][p][/p][p]We’d like to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has supported us! We are very proud of the work we’ve done, and we couldn’t have done it without all the suggestions and amazing feedback we’ve gotten.[/p][p][/p][p]If you need game support, we are here! Please let us know if you run into any issues. You can also join our Discord to share feedback, bugs, or just chat about the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We still have a lot of work to do and look forward to making this game even more awesome as we work towards our 1.0 launch.[/p][p]
We would greatly appreciate it if you could share the game with your favourite streamers and YouTubers to help spread the word!

We hope you enjoy the game! 🚀[/p]

notes.title: Command Deck Early Access is Launching September 24, 2025!
notes.content: [p]We’re very excited to announce that Command Deck will enter Early Access on September 24, 2025![/p][p][/p][p]Development of Command Deck has been a long journey and we’re thrilled to reach this milestone. The enthusiasm and feedback from everyone who’s played the demo has been fantastic, and we’re really looking forward to having the community engage with the full game in Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to say a huge thank you to everyone who has played our demo and offered us feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you'll enjoy the new content this release has to offer.  Pick up Command Deck on September 24th to join us  as we work through a long list of features, polish, and content still to come.[/p]

notes.title: Command Deck is in Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]Steam Next Fest is here, and Command Deck is participating! Our demo is live, and now would be a great time for you to check it out![/p][p][/p][p]Want to help us out? Here are a few things you can do:[/p][list][*][p]Play (or replay!) the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Leave a review on the Steam page[/p][/*][*][p]Share Command Deck with your friends[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3733200/Command_Deck_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]A big thank you to everyone that has been playtesting, making suggestions, reporting bugs, and helping us improve the demo![/p][p][/p][p]We really appreciate your support![/p]
